body:
After BURROW's emit_c.go gained real defstruct/get-field support, updated and re-verified this project's own real rect_probe.prn (the file that originally found the gap). Its ORIGINAL version constructed and returned a new Rect -- confirmed live that construction is still deliberately unsupported by either burrow target: it now fails with a real, honest 'emit_c: unknown identifier Rect' error, not a silent miscompile. Rewritten to the real, working slice instead: a struct parameter plus a real get-field read, scalar return (rect-left-child-width) -- verified burrow build -> gcc -Wall -Wextra -> run, correct result (710 for a 1440-wide rect with a 20px border). NORTHSTAR.md updated with the real, narrower current scope for Phase 2 (structs can be passed in and read, not yet constructed -- a real, concrete constraint for that phase's own next scoping pass). DUNG commit 1647b97.

⚓ ☃
title: Real BURROW unblock verified against rect_probe.prn; construction gap named honestly
